title: Integrate facts and managed Nix source
goal: After T001 and T002 are terminal and independently reviewed, integrate exactly their reviewed source commits in the Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree into one reviewed non-main Heim-PC integration revision, prove the integration contains no unrelated source changes, and create a leased content-addressed whole-source artifact that becomes the only source for T004. T005 remains an intentionally independent component patch and is combined with this integration only by T007.

approval.note: This task may read and mutate the exclusively reserved Heim-PC Git object/ref store only through its Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree and run-scoped non-main workspace branch, and may create the bound activation-source artifact. Workspace path, branch and frozen baseline are generated and recorded by Bureau for the exact run rather than being fixed shared names in the TaskSpec. It does not merge to main and grants no runtime, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or production-cutover authority.

acceptance.assertion: Integration begins only after T001 and T002 are terminal and independently reviewed; evidence binds each exact terminal Git commit/tree, its reviewed task evidence and the exact common integration base. Missing, dirty, unpublished or ambiguous source identity fails closed before integration mutation.

Before reading commit/tree objects or creating integration refs, the task holds the exclusive component.heim-pc.nixos-source-integration claim materialized as path:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git; lease loss or object/ref-store drift fails closed before another Git mutation.

Before the first Git/index/tree mutation, the execution envelope contains a non-null Bureau workspace whose workspace_path, workspace_branch, baseline_commit and source_head_at_intent are bound to this exact run. All integration mutation and validation occurs only there; a missing workspace, reused fixed integration worktree, branch mismatch, dirty preimage or run/workspace identity drift fails closed.

A non-main integration revision is produced inside the exact run-scoped workspace from exactly the reviewed T001 and T002 terminal source revisions using a receipt-bound merge/rebase/cherry-pick plan. Any conflict is explicitly reviewed, and tree comparison proves the result contains the intended union of those changes plus no unrelated source delta.

The exact integration commit is published only from the Bureau-recorded run-scoped non-main workspace branch, and remote readback proves the published ref resolves to the reviewed commit/tree. No moving branch name alone is accepted by successor tasks; the terminal receipt carries exact commit and tree identities.

Focused T001/T002 tests and required Heim-PC repository validation are green in the exact run-scoped integration worktree on the exact integration commit, and an independent review finds no material integration regression before the source artifact is published.

While holding the exclusive artifact.heim-pc.nixos-activation-source write claim, T006 creates a content-addressed whole-source artifact and immutable manifest from the exact reviewed integration commit. The manifest binds Git commit/tree, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity; immediate independent re-hash/readback proves artifact contents match the bound source tree.

The T006 terminal evidence designates the content-addressed activation-source artifact as T004's only build-source input and exposes the exact integration commit/tree to T007 as one reviewed integration input. T005 does not consume or claim this revision as its workspace baseline. T004/T007 fail closed on any different artifact, commit/tree or source identity.
T006 performs no main-branch merge, production NixOS activation, partitioning, formatting, LUKS/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, reboot or equivalent production-cutover effect.

metadata.workspace_contract: Bureau run-scoped worktree and non-main branch recorded in the execution envelope
